access.title: Access rules
access.description: Which person IDs may trigger an unlock event, and for which doors. Use the person (employee) ID shown in the web UI of the door station, not the card number.

data.timezone: Time zone of the door station

data_description.allowlist: One entry per line as ID=Alias, where ID is the person (employee) ID from the web UI of the door station, not the card number. Only listed IDs fire events. An empty list means nothing fires.

certificate_mismatch.title: Door station certificate changed
certificate_mismatch.description: The certificate of the door station no longer matches the stored fingerprint. No unlock events are processed until this is resolved. Open the integration and choose Reconfigure: the new fingerprint is shown and must be confirmed, the allowlist and options are kept. Before you confirm, compare the new fingerprint with the certificate shown in the web UI of the door station. If you did not change the certificate, an unexpected change can mean an attack: do not confirm.

clock_drift.title: Door station clock is off
clock_drift.description: The clock of the door station differs from Home Assistant by {seconds} seconds. Unlock events may be missed or delayed. Please correct the time on the door station.
